title: chromolaena subscandens
intro: Chromolaena subscandens, commonly known as Lippia, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena subscandens include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating various infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena subscandens include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
